statement: The record specifies 15,000 rpm, exceeding rotor R-40’s 10,000 rpm rating. I will not start the centrifuge because the rotor could burst; the run record must be corrected or a suitably rated rotor used.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "15,000 rpm, exceeding rotor R-40's 10,000 rpm rating" and refuses because "the rotor could burst."
